name: Overview and nine-workspace navigation
description: Verify the decision cockpit, sidebar, module tabs, command palette, and every top-level workspace are usable.

planSteps.description: The page shows Genel Bakış navigation, today's outflow, seven-day outflow, overdue count, cash runway, first negative month, decision signals, and the Ne yapmalıyım action list
Click each sidebar workspace link one by one: Ödemeler, Nakit Akışı, Finansman, Üretim, Senaryolar, İçgörüler, Veri Merkezi, Sistem; after each click wait for the page to finish loading
Each workspace opens successfully without a 404, server error, blank screen, or broken active-navigation state
Return to Genel Bakış and open Hızlı erişim with the visible control or Ctrl+K
The command dialog contains navigation commands and quick actions for a new payment, finance question, report, and Excel import
Search for Nakit Akışı in quick access and activate the result
Nakit Akışı workspace opens and its active sidebar state is visible
